import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long sn = 10000000, sd = 1;
        int den = 1;
        do {
            double ap = (double) x * den / (double) y;
            long num = (long) ap;
            if (ap - (double) num > 0.5) num++;
            if (y * den * Math.abs(x * sd - sn * y) > y * sd * Math.abs(x * den - num * y)) {
                sn = num;
                sd = den;
            }
            den++;
        } while (den <= n);
        System.out.println(sn + "/" + sd);
        sc.close();
    }
}
